title: Toyota Land Cruiser 76 Hardtop
longDescription: The Toyota Land Cruiser 76 Hardtop is a rugged, purpose-built off-road vehicle combining legendary 70 Series durability with modern refinements. Featuring a robust chassis, heavy-duty suspension, and optional armor upgrades, it is engineered for demanding terrain and security applications. The spacious interior offers comfort with tan/brown leather upholstery, modern infotainment, and climate control. Equipped with a snorkel, winch-ready bumper, and all-terrain tires, the Land Cruiser 76 Hardtop is ready for any mission.
